common:generalComment.#text: Calcined coke is a high purity carbon material produced by heating green petroleum coke to drive off moisture, volatile matter, and impurities and to increase its electrical conductivity. It is used primarily in the production of anodes for aluminium smelting, as well as in graphite electrodes for electric arc furnaces and in carbon raisers in steel and foundry industries. The production route typically involves delayed coking, and the product is available to consumers and at plant level.
煅烧焦炭是一种高纯度碳材料，通过加热石油焦来驱除水分、挥发分和杂质，并提高其电导率而制成。它主要用于铝冶炼阳极的生产，以及电弧炉用石墨电极和钢铁及铸造行业中的碳升高剂。生产路线通常涉及延迟焦化过程，产品可供消费者使用，也可在工厂级别获取。
